speakers.name: Peter Banda
speakers.topic: From Strategy to Execution: Project Management Essentials for Marketing Leaders
speakers.bio: Peter Banda is a celebrated project management consultant in Southern Africa. With over 20 years of experience aligning project lifecycles with corporate strategy, he helps CMOs and marketing teams establish structured execution methodologies to secure high ROI and flawless campaign launches.

speakers.name: Kugandrie Govender
speakers.topic: The Modern Marketing Practitioner: Blending Data, Creativity & Ethics in African Markets
speakers.bio: Kugandrie Govender is a respected marketing academic and practitioner, currently heading IMM South Africa's academic efforts. She specialises in data-driven marketing frameworks, ethical digital strategies, and equipping SADC brand leaders with globally benchmarked continuous professional development.

speakers.name: Gerald Ngonyamo
speakers.topic: Digital Brand Storytelling: Creating Compelling Narratives for Social & Content Marketing
speakers.bio: Gerald Ngonyamo serves as the Head of Corporate Affairs & PR for MultiChoice. He brings exceptional insight into digital entertainment, narrative strategy, user-generated content engagement, and crisis communications across pan-African digital ecosystems.

speakers.name: Shalmore Khuleya
speakers.position: Professional Channel Manager, Greater Zambezi Cluster
speakers.topic: Keep the Core, Own the Market: Brand Consistency vs Local Relevance
speakers.bio: Shalmore Khuleya is Nestlé's Channel Manager for the Greater Zambezi Cluster. He drives brand development and distribution across high-growth sub-Saharan markets, reconciling strict global brand governance with powerful local cultural and commercial adaptation levers.

speakers.name: Dr Sibongile Tino Jamela
speakers.topic: Building Brand Advocacy: Engaging Stakeholders in Zimbabwe's Multi-Sector Economy
speakers.bio: Dr Sibongile Tino Jamela is the Managing Director of Effective Media. With deep insights across parastatals, financial services, and FMCG sectors, she is an expert on corporate reputation, multi-stakeholder mapping, brand advocacy, and proving marketing value to boards.

speakers.name: Tricea Valentine
speakers.topic: Marketing Measurement and ROI: Proving Your Value in a Data-Driven Organisation
speakers.bio: Tricea Valentine is an expert software product leader at RAIC Labs. She is passionate about tech disruption, building scalable analytics tools, automated attribution pathways, and helping marketers validate campaign metrics with precision financial forecasting models.

speakers.name: Mr F Mambondiani
speakers.topic: Closing Ceremony & SADC-Wide Professional Certification Handover
speakers.bio: Mr F Mambondiani leads the MAZ Business Institute (MAZBI). He has championed SADC-wide continuous professional developments for over a decade. He supervises SADC co-branding alliances such as the IMM South Africa partnership, ensuring certificates hold prestigious regional academic weight.

testimonials.name: Collins Tonhodzayi
testimonials.text: Attending the Winterschool at Tamarind, Kariba in 2024 was a defining moment in my professional journey. Sponsored by Delta Beverages, I came in expecting to refine my sales skills — but what I gained was a complete transformation in how I think, plan, and execute. Since completing the program and attaining my Sales Practitioner status, I secured 2nd Position in the Supersurprise Nationwide Event (2026) and 4th Position at the Chibuku Sales Rally. It's not just a course, it's a catalyst for real success.

testimonials.name: Kudzanayi Mudhanyani
testimonials.text: The most enduring value has been the shift in how I approach marketing as a driver of enterprise value. The program's deep dive into Financial Forecasting gave me the framework to align marketing objectives with the organisation's bottom-line targets, de-risk investments through data-backed projections, and communicate value to the board in the language of ROI. MAZBI doesn't just refine marketing skills — it matures the marketing leader's perspective.

testimonials.name: Tinashe Sanyamawe
testimonials.text: The MAZBI Winter School was a transformative experience that strengthened my approach to strategic thinking, leadership, and innovation. The programme challenged me to adopt a more insight-driven approach to problem-solving while connecting me with forward-thinking professionals. I highly recommend the MAZBI Winter School to anyone looking to accelerate their professional and leadership development.

testimonials.name: Linda Matowa
testimonials.text: The 2025 CPD Winter School was a real eye-opener! It drove home the point that marketers need to show the value they bring to the table — we're not just a cost centre, we're revenue drivers! Kudos to the presenters for covering hot topics like aligning marketing and sales, and the rise of personalisation. I'm already implementing some of these strategies to boost our marketing impact.

venue.title: Tamarind Resort, Kariba
venue.overview: Tamarind Resort sits majestically directly on the shores of Lake Kariba, offering awe-inspiring views, beautiful sub-tropical gardens, and newly refurbished spaces that seamlessly blend modern African luxury with exceptional hospitality. An ideal professional sanctuary.
venue.accommodation: Newly refurbished luxury King Bedrooms. Features premium king beds, plush therapeutic linens, rich custom timber headboards, energy-efficient modern cooling, and warm LED ambient systems.
venue.conference: Modernised Conference Rooms + Breakaway Hubs + a traditional thatch-roofed Lakeside CBR venue, fitted with state-of-the-art acoustics, wide-screen A/V projections, and dual-layer high-speed Wi-Fi matrices.
venue.views: Majestic open prospects over Lake Kariba lake-shores, beautiful outdoor sunset dining structures, deep blue pool lounges, and a glorious lake sunset view deck.
amenities: Lakeside Swimming Pool & Poolside Braai Pit
Free secure shuttle services inside the resort grounds

adventures.title: Sunset Cruise on Lake Kariba
adventures.description: Board the iconic gold and yellow double-deck Lake Kariba Cruise Vessel. Enjoy standard two storeys of open observation decks combined with shaded lower dining lounges, full catering service, and elephant spotting along the river shorelines at sunset.

adventures.title: Game Drives in Kariba National Park
adventures.description: A guided high-clearance truck safari traversing beautiful paths along the shores of Lake Kariba to observe herds of elephants, antelopes, zebras, and native birdlife in their historic natural terrains.

adventures.title: Exciting Quad Biking Trails
adventures.description: Rev up your quad bike and follow experienced guides across the rustic paths, scenic lakeside ridges, and dusty bush tracks of Kariba for an blood-pumping team adventure.

adventures.title: Lakeside Networking Sundowners
adventures.description: Share stories, drinks, and network informally with CMOs and parastatal directors on the sundowner terrace of Tamarind Resort, directly overlooking Africa's greatest man-made waters.

adventures.title: Warm Bonfire and Traditional Braai
adventures.description: Settle in for a traditional Zimbabwean braai dinner next to a crackling hardwood bonfire under the clear, crisp June Kariba sky, accompanied by local acoustic ambient sounds and networking.
